items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 18 July 2026 7:25am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 18 July 2026 at 7:25am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Occasional strong winds.


##Synopsis##

High pressure centred to the south of Iceland, with ridges to the Norwegian Sea and Britain.


##Wind##

Variable 3 or less in places throughout, otherwise mainly North or Northwest 3 to 5, increasing 4 or 5 occasionally 6 in the west of the area for a time this morning and at first this afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, becoming slight or moderate in the west of the area this morning, then falling smooth or slight in all waters overnight.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Veering North or Northeast 3 to 5, but staying Variable 3 or less in places, backing North or Northwest 4 or 5 in all waters later.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, becoming slight occasionally moderate later.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
